review_candidates.title: Document Controller
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Position Snapshot Title: Document Controller Location: Cairo, Egypt Position Type: Full Time Department: Legal Affairs Area of Contribution: All Agthia Entities Purpose of the Role: To maintain a reliable, secure and accessible legal records environment across Agthia Group. The role manages the full document lifecycle, supports legal operations and governance administration, and ensures that contracts, corporate records, templates, trackers and supporting documents are complete, correctly filed,
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Legal Document & Records Management Manage the receipt, classification, indexing, filing, storage, retrieval, archiving and disposal of legal documents in line with approved requirements. Qualifications: 2 - 4 years of relevant experience in document control, legal administration, records management, governance support or a similar role. Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and document management systems.
